rules.rule_context:
COMPLIANCE NOTE - BSA/AML Enhanced Due Diligence Requirements

Any individual identified as a politically exposed person (PEP), including foreign senior officials, current or former, and their close associates or family members, requires enhanced due diligence prior to account onboarding. A PEP hit from screening is not cleared by standard KYC alone. EDD must include source-of-funds and source-of-wealth documentation, enhanced ongoing monitoring, and senior compliance officer approval before the account is activated. There is no expedited path that bypasses these requirements. If a PEP match is present on any party to the account, standard KYC procedures are insufficient and the account cannot be opened until EDD is completed and signed off.
